newsitem.title: UK: Cadbury to focus on brands after CCSB deal.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury to focus on brands after CCSB deal.

text.p: Drinks and confectionery group Cadbury Schweppes Plc said on Wednesday that European Commission approval of the sale of its 51 percent stake in Coca-Cola Schweppes Beverages Ltd to Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc would release funds for developing its branded business worldwide.
The European Commission approved the acquisition, saying that Coca-Cola's role in CCSB was already so large that the deal would not strengthen its market position.

Cadbury chairman Dominic Cadbury said, "The deal will allow us to realise funds hitherto tied up in bottling assets and devote them to our primary purpose - the growth of our branded business worldwide."
Under the deal, announced on June 4, Cadbury will receive 623 million stg for its stake in CCSB, which bottles, cans and distributes Cadbury Schweppes and Coca-Cola products throughout Britain.

Established in 1987 as a joint venture between Cadbury Schweppes and The Coca-Cola Company, CCSB also distributes brands of other companies including mineral water brands from Nestle SA, Capri-Sun and Appletise under separate agreements. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
